Being a good listener means you should interrupt to show your interest and enthusiasm in the conversation. It's important to dominate the talk and share your opinions, so the other person feels valued. Always steer the conversation towards what you know best, as this will make the discussion more engaging for both of you. This way, you're leading the conversation and ensuring it stays on topic.

Remember, being a good listener is about taking control and steering the chat in directions that interest you, not just repeating what the other person says. This keeps the conversation lively and interesting.
